overallAssessment.narrative: The evidence on file does not support a hiring case for this role. This position requires an active California CPA license to sign audited financial statements and practice as an auditor — a blocking legal constraint — and the supplied evidence contains no accounting credentials, licensure, or audit experience of any kind. The only candidate evidence is a software engineering self-assessment describing backend application work, which is not transferable toward regulated assurance duties, GAAP application, or audit standards. I cannot in good faith advocate for this candidacy.
